item.description: ### Fixed - **AI Guard, Undo:** undoing an update to the control rule now puts back only what Apply changed, so edits made in AI Guard since are kept. - **Private Access, Manage:** the ordered delete now treats a list ZPA answered oddly as unreadable and holds back the deletes that depend on it, instead of reading it as empty and calling an object unused. - **Undo after a lost answer:** when Private Access, Digital Experience or Zscaler didn't answer an update (a segment or rule updated in place, an app or probe switched on, a Policy Simulator change), it's now recorded so Undo can take it back. A new object with no answer is reported as possibly created. - **Client Connector, Devices & Install:** Disconnect, or switching to another tenant, now clears the values typed into the install builder, including passwords and the policy token. - **Undo and drift:** a run record whose created object points outside its own kind's list is no longer offered. - **Client Connector:** profile lists longer than one page are read in full, and a forwarding profile is deleted only once no app profile on any platform uses it (iOS, Android and Linux included).
